login.inAppBody: Google sign-in doesn't work here. Log in with email below, or open PronoHub in your browser (menu ⋮).
loadingMessages: The ref still has the ball, going to fetch it…
Checking if VAR approves the loading…
The server got nutmegged, it's on its way back…
Looking for the connection… it's hiding behind the defence.
Holding it up… like a target man back to goal.
Warming up: our servers are taking free kicks.
Waiting for the keeper to stop trash-talking.
Building a chance… just need to hit the target.
Playing it out from the back… loads better.
Kick-off in a moment… ref's promise.
Formation set: 4-4-2… 4 seconds, 4 bits of data, 2 coffees.
Passing the data around… loading tiki-taka.

rules.title: Tournament rules
rules.exactScore: Exact score: {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
rules.correctResult: Correct result (win/draw/loss): {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
rules.goodQualifier: Correct qualifier for the next round: <o>1 point</o>
rules.bonusMatchDesc: A bonus match is picked each matchday. Points earned on this match are doubled! The bonus match is marked with a badge
rules.earlyBonusDesc: One bonus point per matchday if all fixtures are predicted before the deadline (30 minutes before kick-off). A single miss loses this point: helps fight no-shows.
rules.knockoutDesc: Predictions for knockout matches are scored on the 90-minute score, excluding extra time and any penalty shootouts.
rules.qualifierBonusDesc1: For each knockout match, you can predict the team that qualifies for the next round. Earns
rules.qualifierBonusDesc2: extra if your prediction is correct.
rules.teamsDesc: On top of the individual ranking, a team ranking is available. A team's score is the average of the points of its members. Check the "Teams" tab to see the team compositions.
rules.configAll: For this tournament, you chose all competition matchdays.
rules.configN: For this tournament, you chose {n} competition {n, plural, one {matchday} other {matchdays}}.
rules.configFinal: It ends up running over {n} {n, plural, one {matchday} other {matchdays}}.
rules.deadlineDesc: Predictions must be entered at least 30 minutes before kick-off. If this deadline isn't met, a 0-0 score is used and cannot earn more than {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} for a correct result or exact score.
rules.rankingDesc: The ranking is updated after each matchday. In case of a tie, the number of exact scores separates players.
